review_description: Very positive experience with Solar Share project. Easy to talk to, happy to answer questions, always responded quickly and gave us very clear information. They spent some time putting together different options at different price points for us. Install seems to be very well done, high quality work and attention to detail, and got it done fast, exactly when they said they would. Did the entire job themselves, not using subcontractors. Their quotes were significantly cheaper than other high-end installers. So far the system is performing very well.

Just got my solar installed by Aaron and the team and have to say the experience has been great from start to finish! Aaron guided me through the whole process and took his time to explain the million questions I had. When it came to install the team were professional, it was a harder tile roof install and they did not rush to just get it done they took a bit more to get it done right. Huge thanks team!

I did shop around and wanted to partner with an organisation that employed their own team rather than using sub-contractors, provided great after sales/installation service and would be up front with information and any hidden issues we might need.Solar Share Project provided some great information and answered all my questions.They designed a system to maximise the number of panels on our roof and even factored in the moving of our whirlybirds to ensure that the roof space could incorporate all the panels.The installation and communication was excellent, the team friendly and courteous and a walkthrough of the system explained in easy to understand terms and the site left clean and tidy.

Very happy with Solar Share Project. Great customer service and helped to choose the best system for my needs. Came out to measure up and gave sound advice. The installers also were very friendly and did a great job. Very happy overall with the customer service, system and installation. Would recommend to anyone.

Really helpful guys, they walked me through the process and helped to select the right system for me. Great work on the installation, it looks great and they were courteous and tidy the whole time.On top of all that it was the most competitive quote for the size and type of system.The system almost perfectly offsets all my daily use.

Aaron, Corey & Pete did an amazing job installing our 10kW system. When we first considered a solar install, I had a good chat with Aaron and he did a great job mapping out a few options for us and he went through how the pay off periods worked out when you factor in selling your surplus back to the grid. We opted for a larger system than our everyday household usage required and we could not be happier with the results.

Can’t speak highly enough of Aaron and Solar Share Project!Aaron has been nothing but upfront, honest, reliable & on time with all of our solar quoting & install. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend him and his company to all my family & friends.Thanks Aaron for your great work!

After getting a number of quotes from (some via Solar Quotes, some elsewhere) I always felt I was being "pitched" to, and the rep was more sales-focused than actually looking at my issues. After a personal recommendation, I had Aaron from Solar Share Project over and was much more comfortable going ahead than before. He organised the install date incredibly quickly and went above and beyond in the actual work. My terrace house is old, and while I thought we may have had some issues, neither of us could have predicted some of the challenges. Despite that, he worked with me to find solutions, and I couldn't be happier. Still early days, but he continues to communicate promptly, and has been adjusting settings and keeping in touch about the fine-tuning in getting my system at peak performance
Aaron is really knowledgeable, not just solar, but rates, inverters, batteries, the works! Great system on my terrace in Chippendale for a great price. Highly recommended!
